attributes.probed_form: NO SOURCE CHANGE; this was entirely a guard capability. THE MEASUREMENT THAT DECIDED IT, and it is the part worth carrying: of the 64 complete relocation-consistent matchings of the window [0xf0,0x138), ZERO pass check_permutation_dependences under the shipped single-'mem' model — reproducing HV's exhaustive refusal exactly — and 16 pass once the three EMB_SDA21 accesses are separated by their proved addresses; all 16 reach the target bytes, and exactly 2 pass the full chain (dependences + copy_register_fields + verify_consistent_recolor). The recorded order is [1,0,5,3,2,6,7,8,4,9,11,10,13,12,14,16,17,15]; the runner-up differs only in exchanging our `li r6,0` and `li r10,0` against the target's identically-named instructions, which costs 6 register-field changes where the identity pairing costs 4 and would gratuitously recolour two identical constant loads. A SOUNDNESS TRAP FOUND WHILE BUILDING IT, and the reason the first measurement was wrong: splitting some accesses out of the single 'mem' resource silently makes every REMAINING plain-'mem' access non-conflicting with exactly the locations just separated. The shipped implementation therefore promotes every undeclared memory access to 'anymem' the moment any location is declared; the 16/2 counts above are from the corrected, conservative model, and the first run of the prototype (before the promotion) is not the number.
attributes.residual: NONE. fn_8005FDA8 is EXACT. WHAT THE PROOF RESTS ON, precisely, because the obvious version of this is unsound: distinct symbol NAMES are NOT the argument — two names can alias. The argument is ADDRESSES, taken from config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt, which is the same split map dtk splits by and the link is placed by and which the DOL checksum gate already rests on; the names only bind the declaration to the object. Every declared location must additionally be a D-form access whose base field is the SDA placeholder zero (so the linked effective address comes entirely from the relocation and not from a register value the audit cannot track), must carry exactly one EMB_SDA21 relocation naming exactly the declared symbol, must agree with the map on section, address and access width, and the declared ranges must be pairwise disjoint. Here: .sbss 0x80344194 (the store), .sdata2 0x80346F50 (the load) and .sbss 0x80344190 (the second store). Anything unresolved stays coarse, so the capability can only ever be exercised where the map answers.
